title: Andy Weir's 'Exoplanet' just landed on Audible, but what actually makes an exoplanet habitable?
caption:
Could you survive on an exoplanet? It takes more than just the right temperature to make a world truly habitable. Here is the science behind the fiction of Audible's new thriller, Exoplanet.
